question: The term 'checkmate' is used in which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Chess__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Checkmate**__

 __
 
• One of the most well-known terms in the **chess world is "checkmate."**
 
• A checkmate in chess refers to a **move in which your opponent has no further choices because you have obtained their king and the game has been won**.
 
• According to the **Barnhart Etymological Dictionary**, the term "checkmate" **is a modification of the Persian expression "the King is helpless."**
 
• Using the hash **symbol "#," a checkmating move is noted in algebraic notation**.
 
• Other terms that are used in chess are **check, Gambit, Bishop, pawn, stalemate**, etc.
